method: Heat oil in a pan and add the onions, garlic, and chopped brinjal.
Then add all the other vegetables and tomatoes.
Add salt, chili powder, and the required amount of water, then let it boil.
Once the gravy thickens slightly, remove the pan from heat.
For aroma, add chopped coriander leaves and curry leaves.
notes: Note: This goes very well with both chapathi and rice.
